black.$description: Reference black, for shadows and scrim only.

primary.$description: Brand teal: filled buttons, active nav indicator, focus ring, links, selected controls. As text on surface tiers (light 6.3:1+, dark 9:1+).

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill.

primary-container.$description: Tonal button, selected nav item, selected filter chip fill.

inverse-primary.$description: Action text inside a snackbar (on inverse-surface).

surface-container-lowest.$description: Intentional addition (M3): camera-grid well, input backgrounds on tinted panels.

surface-container-low.$description: Elevation level 1 tonal surface: cards, sidebar.

surface-container.$description: Elevation level 2: menus, navigation bar, top bar on scroll.

surface-container-high.$description: Elevation level 3: dialogs, bottom sheets, search field.

surface-container-highest.$description: Intentional addition (M3): levels 4–5, switch track off, skeleton base.

on-surface.$description: Primary text and icons on every surface tier (≥12:1 light, ≥10:1 dark).

on-surface-variant.$description: Secondary text, metadata, inactive icons, on every surface tier (≥8:1 light, ≥8:1 dark).

outline.$description: Control borders (text field, outlined button, checkbox), ≥3:1 on all surfaces.

outline-variant.$description: Decorative dividers and card outlines only — never the only boundary of a control.

inverse-surface.$description: Intentional addition (M3): snackbar and tooltip container.

critical.$description: URGENT ONLY. Fill = a resident may need help now (Fall, SOS, New incident). As text/icon/outline: validation errors, destructive outlined buttons, outlined critical statuses.

on-critical.$description: Text on a critical fill. Dark value is an intentional addition (M3 error-on); the brief did not list it.

critical-strong.$description: Alert banners and critical-alert takeover header fills, which always carry white text (on-critical-strong). Light aliases the same tone as critical.

critical-container.$description: Tinted background behind critical text: error banner body, alert card wash.

warning.$description: Acknowledged, Moderate risk, Degraded, Detection paused: icon, outline and text.

on-warning.$description: Text on a warning fill. Dark value is an intentional addition.

success.$description: Resolved, Online, Active, Low risk, Operational: icon, outline and text.

on-success.$description: Text on a success fill. Dark value is an intentional addition.

on-info.$description: Text on an info fill. Dark value is an intentional addition.

neutral-status.$description: False alarm, Offline, Deactivated: icon and outline; as text on surface tiers.

scrim.$description: Modal scrim behind dialogs, sheets and the critical alert takeover (#000 at 60%).

shadow-color.$description: Key and ambient shadow colour for elevation levels.

1.$description: Categorical series 1 (teal). Data only — never status. Never next to a critical value without a label.

2.$description: Categorical series 2 (blue). Data only — never status. Never next to a critical value without a label.

3.$description: Categorical series 3 (violet). Data only — never status. Never next to a critical value without a label.

4.$description: Categorical series 4 (ochre). Data only — never status. Never next to a critical value without a label.

5.$description: Categorical series 5 (olive). Data only — never status. Never next to a critical value without a label.

6.$description: Categorical series 6 (plum). Data only — never status. Never next to a critical value without a label.

incident-new-bg.$description: New / Unacknowledged incident — the only filled-red chip. Chip container.

incident-new-fg.$description: New / Unacknowledged incident — the only filled-red chip. Label and icon, on status-incident-new-bg.

incident-new-border.$description: New / Unacknowledged incident — the only filled-red chip. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

incident-acknowledged-fg.$description: Acknowledged incident. Label and icon, on status-incident-acknowledged-bg.

incident-acknowledged-border.$description: Acknowledged incident. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

incident-confirmed-fg.$description: Confirmed incident (outlined critical). Label and icon, on status-incident-confirmed-bg.

incident-confirmed-border.$description: Confirmed incident (outlined critical). 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

incident-false-alarm-fg.$description: False alarm. Label and icon, on status-incident-false-alarm-bg.

incident-false-alarm-border.$description: False alarm. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

incident-resolved-fg.$description: Resolved incident. Label and icon, on status-incident-resolved-bg.

incident-resolved-border.$description: Resolved incident. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

alert-fall-bg.$description: Alert type Fall (person_alert icon). Chip container.

alert-fall-fg.$description: Alert type Fall (person_alert icon). Label and icon, on status-alert-fall-bg.

alert-fall-border.$description: Alert type Fall (person_alert icon). 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

alert-sos-bg.$description: Alert type SOS (sos icon + 'SOS' label). Chip container.

alert-sos-fg.$description: Alert type SOS (sos icon + 'SOS' label). Label and icon, on status-alert-sos-bg.

alert-sos-border.$description: Alert type SOS (sos icon + 'SOS' label). 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

camera-online-fg.$description: Camera online. Label and icon, on status-camera-online-bg.

camera-online-border.$description: Camera online. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

camera-offline-fg.$description: Camera offline. Label and icon, on status-camera-offline-bg.

camera-offline-border.$description: Camera offline. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

camera-error-bg.$description: Camera no signal / error (outlined critical). Chip container.

camera-error-fg.$description: Camera no signal / error (outlined critical). Label and icon, on status-camera-error-bg.

camera-error-border.$description: Camera no signal / error (outlined critical). 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

camera-paused-fg.$description: Detection paused. Label and icon, on status-camera-paused-bg.

camera-paused-border.$description: Detection paused. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

camera-connecting-fg.$description: Camera connecting. Label and icon, on status-camera-connecting-bg.

camera-connecting-border.$description: Camera connecting. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

account-active-fg.$description: User account active. Label and icon, on status-account-active-bg.

account-active-border.$description: User account active. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

account-deactivated-fg.$description: User account deactivated. Label and icon, on status-account-deactivated-bg.

account-deactivated-border.$description: User account deactivated. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

risk-low-fg.$description: Fall-risk Low. Label and icon, on status-risk-low-bg.

risk-low-border.$description: Fall-risk Low. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

risk-moderate-fg.$description: Fall-risk Moderate. Label and icon, on status-risk-moderate-bg.

risk-moderate-border.$description: Fall-risk Moderate. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

risk-high-bg.$description: Fall-risk High (outlined critical — a risk level is not an emergency). Chip container.

risk-high-fg.$description: Fall-risk High (outlined critical — a risk level is not an emergency). Label and icon, on status-risk-high-bg.

risk-high-border.$description: Fall-risk High (outlined critical — a risk level is not an emergency). 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

system-operational-fg.$description: System health Operational. Label and icon, on status-system-operational-bg.

system-operational-border.$description: System health Operational. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

system-degraded-fg.$description: System health Degraded. Label and icon, on status-system-degraded-bg.

system-degraded-border.$description: System health Degraded. 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

system-down-bg.$description: System health Down (outlined critical; no resident is in danger by itself). Chip container.

system-down-fg.$description: System health Down (outlined critical; no resident is in danger by itself). Label and icon, on status-system-down-bg.

system-down-border.$description: System health Down (outlined critical; no resident is in danger by itself). 1px chip border (≥3:1 on surface).

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus: 3px solid ring, 2px offset, every interactive element.

button-destructive-label.$description: Destructive (outlined critical) button label and border. Never filled.

nav-active-indicator.$description: Active pill behind the selected nav item.

field-error.$description: Validation error: text, icon, 2px border. Never a red fill.

alert-border-new.$description: Alert card border while New (pulses twice, then solid).

alert-wash-new.$description: Alert card header wash while New.

sos-fill.$description: SOS button fill (urgent action; one of the two places a red fill is allowed).

camera-well.$description: Camera video well (always dark so footage reads, both themes).

camera-overlay-text.$description: Text on the camera scrim overlay.
